name: Site Health Check

# Verifies the live site is actually serving. Designed to avoid false alarms:
# each check retries with a back-off (Cloudflare edge cold-starts / transient
# network blips must not turn the run red). Only a real, repeated failure does.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'   # every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  health:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🩺 Homepage, ads.txt and sitemap URLs (with retries)
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          UA="Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; AIToolsNova-HealthCheck/1.0)"

          # fetch_code <url> -> echoes final HTTP code, retrying up to 5 times.
          fetch_code () {
            local url="$1" code="" i
            for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              code=$(curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -A "$UA" --max-time 25 "$url" || echo "000")
              if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "200"; return 0; fi
              echo "  attempt $i: $url -> $code" >&2
              sleep $((i * 5))
            done
            echo "$code"; return 1
          }

          FAIL=0

          HOME_CODE=$(fetch_code "https://aitoolsnova.com/")
          echo "Homepage: $HOME_CODE"
          [ "$HOME_CODE" = "200" ] || { echo "::error::Homepage returned $HOME_CODE (expected 200)"; FAIL=1; }

          ADS_CODE=$(fetch_code "https://aitoolsnova.com/ads.txt")
          echo "ads.txt: $ADS_CODE"
          if [ "$ADS_CODE" = "200" ]; then
            BODY=$(curl -sL -A "$UA" --max-time 25 "https://aitoolsnova.com/ads.txt" || true)
            echo "$BODY"
            echo "$BODY" | grep -q "pub-2278101269918728" || { echo "::error::ads.txt missing publisher ID"; FAIL=1; }
          else
            echo "::error::ads.txt returned $ADS_CODE"; FAIL=1
          fi

          # Check every sitemap URL, but tolerate a handful of transient
          # non-200s: only fail when MORE THAN 3 URLs are broken (real 404s),
          # which indicates a deploy/redirect regression rather than a blip.
          curl -sL -A "$UA" --max-time 25 https://aitoolsnova.com/sitemap.xml -o s.xml
          grep -o '<loc>[^<]*</loc>' s.xml | sed 's|<loc>||;s|</loc>||' > urls.txt
          TOTAL=$(wc -l < urls.txt | tr -d ' ')
          BAD=0; BADURLS=""
          while read -r u; do
            [ -z "$u" ] && continue
            C=$(curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -A "$UA" --max-time 25 "$u" || echo "000")
            if [ "$C" != "200" ]; then
              # retry once for transient failures
              sleep 2
              C=$(curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -A "$UA" --max-time 25 "$u" || echo "000")
            fi
            if [ "$C" != "200" ]; then
              echo "::warning::$C $u"
              BAD=$((BAD+1)); BADURLS="$BADURLS$C $u\n"
            fi
          done < urls.txt
          echo "Sitemap URLs checked: $TOTAL, broken: $BAD"
          if [ "$BAD" -gt 3 ]; then
            echo "::error::$BAD sitemap URLs are not 200"
            printf "$BADURLS" | head -20
            FAIL=1
          fi

          if [ "$FAIL" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "HEALTH_FAILED=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Site healthy: homepage 200, ads.txt OK, sitemap URLs reachable."

      - name: Open issue if site is down
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `🚨 Site health check failed — ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}`;
            const runUrl = `https://github.com/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const body = [
              'The live-site health check failed after retries (homepage / ads.txt / sitemap URLs).',
              '',
              `- Run: ${runUrl}`,
              '',
              'Check Cloudflare Pages deploy status and that the domain/SSL is active. If the site loads fine for you, re-run this workflow once to confirm it is not a transient edge issue.',
            ].join('\n');
            const existing = await github.rest.issues.list({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open', labels: ['site-down'], per_page: 5,
            });
            if (existing.data.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
                title, body, labels: ['site-down', 'monitoring'],
              });
            }
